provenance: machine-readable parameter registry; rotor_torque_constants=0.004665 equals K_tau=4.665e-3 identified in Eschmann, Albani & Loianno, arXiv:2404.07837 (verified earlier, [P1]), consistent with same-origin identification data. NOT a cross-platform mix: every value below comes from this one registry entry.

values_from_source.J_note: Jx=9e-6, Jy=1e-5, Jz=1.7e-5; source diagonal. Jz/Jx=1.889, close to [P1] mean 1.832.

mapping_rationale.a: rotor x/y offsets are +/-0.028 m; our mixer MIX_X=a[1,1,-1,-1], MIX_Y=a[-1,1,1,-1]; magnitude a=0.028 m (sign convention differs; support-function magnitudes unaffected).
mapping_rationale.kappa: yaw torque = K_tau * thrust, so cQ/cT = K_tau = 0.004665 m; source torque directions [-,+,-,+] vs our [+,-,+,-] -> global sign flip, magnitude identical.
mapping_rationale.u_max: SOURCE INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY: f(s)=c0+c1*s+c2*s^2 gives f(0.726139)=0.062593 N != mg/4=0.075047 N (-16.6%). We do NOT copy the absolute curve; we use only its shape ratio u_max = u_hov * f(1)/f(s_hover) = 0.075047 * (0.110128/0.062593) = 0.132039 N. Balances U=[0,u_max]^4 with sum(u)=F.
mapping_rationale.TM_LIST: real actuator has ASYMMETRIC rising/falling time constants (0.055455 / 0.249394 s); our model assumes symmetric first-order lag. Honest bracketing: run two symmetric models at the two measured constants, do not invent an averaged value. Asymmetry documented as model limitation.
mapping_rationale.D_AMP_D_BAR: disturbance level is a design parameter, not platform-identified; scaled to preserve the SAME dimensionless disturbance-to-authority ratio rho=dbar/(a*F) as the synthetic run: rho=0.032/(0.1556*7.848)=0.02621 -> real dbar=0.02621*(0.028*0.300186)=2.2026e-4 N*m; D_AMP=dbar/1.6.
mapping_rationale.T_LP: controller estimator time constant: design choice, unchanged from synthetic run; NOT claimed as identified.
mapping_rationale.cT_Omega: NOT USED. The identified model works in rotor thrust (force) units via a throttle polynomial; RPM-level quantities (cT, Omega_hover, Omega_max) are not separately identified in this registry and are not needed for attitude-only analysis. Hover-RPM sanity check (control-sim-pitfalls §9) is therefore marked N/A for this config, not silently passed.
mapping_rationale.Phi_max_W_th_T_hor: recovery-envelope DESIGN parameters, unchanged; not platform-identified.
mapping_rationale.per_tm_calibration: real actuator has rising 0.055455 s / falling 0.249394 s; a single gain set tuned at 0.055 diverges at 0.249 even with dw=0 (verified). Each Tm gets its own 25-combo equal-budget calibration.
mapping_rationale.dw_grid_max: design probe on real config showed max first_fail_dw=22.81 rad/s; grid extended to 30 to avoid ceiling-truncated fake gap (Amendment-1 class).

known_limitations: Actuator asymmetry (rising vs falling time constants) bracketed, not modeled.
Source registry is a software artifact, not a peer-reviewed paper; Table 1 must cite [P1] arXiv:2404.07837 as the identification source and this registry as the machine-readable parameter file.
Source thrust polynomial does not satisfy its own hover equilibrium; only its shape ratio is used.
No SITL / hardware validation; conclusions remain numerical + analytical.
